notes:
I couldn't do this research. My first attempt to fetch the sources failed with an error saying I had no more research tool calls left, so I couldn't read any pages. The other tools I have can't reach the internet, so I had no other way to get to the sites.

You asked me to report only what the pages actually say and to give a URL for every point. Writing notes from memory would break that rule, so I haven't written any.

If you ask again in a new turn, I'll start by reading these pages:
- **Verse-by-verse commentaries:** enduringword.com/bible-commentary/ezekiel-9/ and the Ezekiel 9 pages for Ellicott, Gill, Pulpit Commentary, Matthew Henry and Wesley's Notes on biblehub.com (for example biblehub.com/commentaries/gill/ezekiel/9.htm). I'd also check preceptaustin.org.
- **Protestant traditions:** searches on spurgeon.org, desiringgod.org, ligonier.org, thegospelcoalition.org and lcms.org. Verse 4 (the mark on the foreheads) and verse 6 ("begin at My sanctuary") are the most likely places for differences.
- **Other views:** the netbible.org notes on the Hebrew word for "mark" (*taw*), and early church writers on newadvent.org who read the mark as a sign of the cross.
